::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## How to use this course on an iPad

1. Open this site in **Safari** (works on Mac/Windows too).
2. Read a lesson, **type or edit code directly in the grey code boxes**, press
   **Run** (▶) and see output right below.
3. Your edits are **saved automatically** in the browser — close the tab and
   come back anytime.
4. Exercises have collapsible **Hints** and **Solutions** — try first, peek later.
5. Cells marked 🧊 *frozen* show real pre-computed output but can't run in the
   browser — run the matching script in `scripts/` locally. Cells with a
   ▶ **Colab badge** open a free cloud notebook (used for single-cell / scanpy).
:::

## What this is

A comprehensive refresher built for a specific learner:

- **R**: you know the basics and package names, but most of your R is
  AI-generated and the syntax feels unpredictable. We fix that with
  **pattern-first R**: every topic reduced to one canonical pattern, plus
  *read-and-refactor-AI-code* drills every week.
- **Python**: you code fine but classes, `__init__`, and architecture are
  shaky. Dedicated lessons in Week 3.
- **Algorithms**: LeetCode beginner. One **Algorithm Gym** day per week,
  progressive and bio-flavored.
- **Reproducibility**: seeds, environments (renv + uv), git, tests, project
  structure — enforced in every weekly project.

Everything is taught **side-by-side**: same task in R and Python.

## Course map

| Week | Theme | Project |
|---|---|---|
| [W1] | Language core side-by-side + The 7 Patterns of R + Gym #1 | P1: messy CSV → tidy dataset, both languages |
| [W2] | Wrangling, ggplot2/matplotlib, statistics + Gym #2 | P2: EDA + stats report (Quarto, seeded) |
| [W3] | Python OOP & architecture, repro stack, testing + Gym #3 | P3: `bioseqkit` R package + Python package w/ CI |
| [W4] | ML (tidymodels ↔ sklearn), sequences, RNA-seq + Gym #4 | P4: DE + classifier mini-study |
| [W5] | Single-cell, trajectories, HMMs, multi-omics | Capstone: end-to-end mini-study |

[W1]: w1/index.qmd
